name: sprint-report
description: Sprint retrospectives and team reports with structured format for achievements, challenges, and planning
purpose: Generate comprehensive sprint retrospectives and team status reports for stakeholders

format.structure: Header > Sprint Overview > Achievements > Challenges > Metrics > Next Steps > Action Items

template:
# Sprint [X] Report

## Sprint Overview
- **Sprint Goal:** [Goal description]
- **Duration:** [Start date] - [End date]
- **Team:** [Team members]

## Key Achievements ✅
- [Achievement 1 with impact]
- [Achievement 2 with impact]

## Challenges & Blockers ⚠️
- [Challenge 1 and resolution]
- [Challenge 2 and mitigation]

## Team Metrics 📊
- **Velocity:** [Points completed]
- **Burndown:** [Status]
- **Quality:** [Metrics]

## Next Sprint Planning 🎯
- **Goals:** [Upcoming objectives]
- **Focus Areas:** [Key priorities]

## Action Items 📋
- [ ] [Action item 1] - Owner: [Name] - Due: [Date]
- [ ] [Action item 2] - Owner: [Name] - Due: [Date]

## Retrospective Insights 💡
**What went well:** [Positive observations]
**What to improve:** [Areas for enhancement]
**Experiments to try:** [Process improvements]
best_practices: Ensure action items have clear owners and deadlines
